curves.name: 12 V-class zener characteristic
curves.page_reference: p. 3, Fig. 3, Zener Characteristics (Vz 12V to 68V); leftmost 12 V-class curve

extraction_notes: The plotted curve is the leftmost 12 V-class trace in the family graph; points are digitized from the visible line in Fig. 3 and reported in SI units.
The 1SMA5927A table gives minimum, nominal, and maximum VZ values of 11.40 V, 12 V, and 12.60 V at IZT = 31.2 mA; the nominal value is recorded.
Fig. 5 capacitance curves were not used because they are generic family curves and do not identify an unambiguous 1SMA5927A value; capacitance is omitted.
No reverse-recovery specification is published in the supplied datasheet.
omission_reason: No target-specific capacitance value or reverse-recovery specification is published; Fig. 5 is a generic family capacitance plot without an unambiguous 1SMA5927A trace.
